==About==

A {{i|Baby Bear}} is the product of a first growth stage, first tier {{i|Pumpkin}} Harvest. Additionally a Baby Bear can be grown by planting another Baby Bear in a {{i|Gardening Pot}} or by chance when Planting a {{i|New World Gourd}}. Planting in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. Right-clicking a Baby Bear and selecting "Slice" will give you 2x {{i|Pumpkin Flesh}} and 6x {{i|Seeds of Pumpkin}}. A Baby Bear can be stored in a {{i|Stockbin}}.
